notes.title: New Kandinhale wood keychains available!
notes.content:
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/WNK74rz.png"]               NEW KANDINHALE KEYCHAINS AVAILABLE ON OUR SHOP!
                                          International shipping & 5 models available



We've been working on Kandinhale merch to be able to bring it to Indie Dev Day (we'll make a new announcement as the dates get closer, stay tuned!) and cover the expenses! In the store we currently have 5 models of  2.5 cm / 0.08 ft cherry wood keychain available. Metal hooks in different colors included. You can get yours by clicking on the link in the image! International shipping available too!
